patch_description: Replace the fixed CZ gates in the linear chain with parametrized CRZ gates, all sharing a single parameter "phi_shared". This adds exactly one trainable parameter (14 → 15) while enabling tunable entanglement strength. The optimizer can now adapt how strongly qubits are entangled, which may improve both convergence and generalization. The linear chain connectivity has consistently outperformed other topologies in prior runs, so we preserve it while making entanglement adaptive rather than fixed.
